_comment: Product catalog for the Naxter storefront (shop.easmoney.me), the sales voice agent (find_product / place_order tools), and the Sales dashboard. 'stock' is the initial inventory; AVAILABLE stock is computed live as stock minus quantities in non-cancelled orders, so the shop + agent + dashboard all see real-time availability without mutating this file. Edit freely.
_confirm_test_number_note: SAFETY: while testing outbound AI confirm-calls, set this to your own mobile so EVERY confirm-call rings that number instead of real customers. Clear it ('') to call real buyers.
